headline: God of War Trilogy Remake is official
title: God of War Trilogy Remake Announced | Greek Kratos Returns | Gaming News
video_script: The Greek God of War games are coming back. Sony officially announced the God of War Trilogy Remake at a State of Play in February twenty twenty six. It remakes God of War one, two and three, and TC Carson, the original voice of Kratos, is involved. Santa Monica Studio says it's in early development, so there's no release date yet. Which game do you want to replay first? Comment below!
description: Sony announced the God of War Trilogy Remake (God of War, II and III) at a February 2026 State of Play. Original Kratos voice actor TC Carson is involved. Early development, no release date.
